A job! A job for you! %s, and I'll pay you %s. Hurry, hurry.
chat.dioriteisntuseless.miner.quest.remi: Our deal, our deal: %s. Only %s of %s. Faster. Faster.
chat.dioriteisntuseless.miner.quest.done: Yes! Yes! It's done! Take it, take %s, take it!

chat.dioriteisntuseless.miner.greeting.1: Ah, there you are. Got any of those crystals for an old miner?
chat.dioriteisntuseless.miner.greeting.2: Folks say diorite is useless. Not me. And not you, I'd wager.
chat.dioriteisntuseless.miner.greeting.3: Bring me all the crystals you can. I pay fair.
chat.dioriteisntuseless.miner.greeting.4: Keep that axe of yours busy, friend. There's plenty more where those came from.
chat.dioriteisntuseless.miner.greeting.5: Good to see you again. The more crystals, the merrier.
chat.dioriteisntuseless.miner.greeting.6: Fifty years down the mines and I've never seen crystals as pretty as yours.
chat.dioriteisntuseless.miner.greeting.e: More! More crystals! You're doing wonderfully. Wonderfully.
I counted the trees on my way here. Fewer every day. Good. Good.
Don't stop. Whatever you hear, don't stop.
The stone is listening today. Isn't it lovely?
I pay better now. Don't ask me why. Just bring them.
Have you been sleeping well? It doesn't matter. Crystals!
It's so quiet down there lately. Too quiet. More crystals, please.
chat.dioriteisntuseless.miner.cutoff.2: Listen, before you go back to that furnace, there's something watch—
chat.dioriteisntuseless.miner.cutoff.3: It isn't the diorite that's useless. It's—
chat.dioriteisntuseless.miner.cutoff.4: Whatever you do, don't let it see you—
chat.dioriteisntuseless.miner.cutoff.5: I'm not supposed to tell you, but it raised them like—
chat.dioriteisntuseless.miner.recovery.3: ...Ha. Old man talk. Pay it no mind.
chat.dioriteisntuseless.miner.farewell.2: There's no going back now. Not for you.
chat.dioriteisntuseless.miner.farewell.3: I'm sorry. I liked you. I won't be coming back.

book.dioriteisntuseless.miner_note.title: Note from The Miner
book.dioriteisntuseless.miner_note.instr:
Name's The Miner. Fifty years under the stone, and I'm still digging.

I don't come by whenever. I come in the morning, when you get up from your bed. Under the sky, mind you. Not in a cave. Never in a cave, they—

Every job I give you is on a paper. Do what it says, then sleep, and I'll be there when you wake. Not done? Then I don't come.

Right-click me and I'll pay you. Emeralds or iron, and fair.

When I come, I take my paper back. Talk to me and you'll get the next one.

Don't keep me waiting. I'm an old man, and I've got places to—

See you around.

— The Miner
There's an old diorite mine not far from here. I dug it with these hands, years back.

The shaft comes up at X %1$s, Z %2$s. If it's caved in, dig.

Down at Y %3$s it turns into a maze. We dug it like that on purpose, so nobody would ever find the—

Take torches. Lots of them.
book.dioriteisntuseless.miner_note.warni:
I couldn't say it out loud. It listens when we talk near the stone.

Every tree you fell, every rock you break with those tools of yours: it keeps count.

Don't ask me what it is. I won't write its name.

Just... use something else, now and then.
book.dioriteisntuseless.miner_note.level:
You didn't stop. I knew you wouldn't.

If you hear static where there's no radio, don't turn around too fast.

It likes to be looked at.
book.dioriteisntuseless.miner_note.farew:
I'm leaving these mines for good.

I bought your crystals and I paid you well. I'm sorry for what they were really paying for.

Keep this one. It's all I can leave you.

— The Miner

screen.dioriteisntuseless.warning.title: ⚠ WARNING
screen.dioriteisntuseless.warning.body:
This mod contains psychological horror elements.

Nothing in this mod will harm your computer, your files or your worlds.
There are no flashing lights. 

But there may be moments that make you jump.

Diorite isn't useless... right?
config.dioriteisntuseless.title: Diorite Isn't Useless
config.dioriteisntuseless.diorite.server: You are connected to a server, so diorite is using the server's values. Changes here apply to your own worlds.
config.dioriteisntuseless.diorite.enable: Diorite uses the hardness and blast resistance below. When off, it is vanilla diorite (1.5 / 6).
config.dioriteisntuseless.diorite.hardne: How long diorite takes to mine. Vanilla: 1.5. Range: 1.5 to 50.
config.dioriteisntuseless.diorite.blastR: How well diorite resists explosions. Vanilla: 6, obsidian: 1200. Range: 6 to 1200.
config.dioriteisntuseless.treeFelling.en: Breaking a log with the Dioritine Axe fells the whole tree. When off, it works like a normal axe: one log at a time and 1 durability per log.
config.dioriteisntuseless.treeFelling.ma: Most logs a single swing can fell, counting the one you hit.
config.dioriteisntuseless.treeFelling.lo: Logs it takes to use 1 durability. 2 means half a point per log.
config.dioriteisntuseless.treeFelling.dr: Drops at the log you hit
On: everything drops together at the log you hit. Off: each log drops where it was.
config.dioriteisntuseless.treeFelling.sn: Whether sneaking stops or starts tree felling.
config.dioriteisntuseless.treeFelling.tr: The axe breaks after felling this many whole trees, no matter its durability. Repairing it on an anvil with Dioritine Ingots resets the count; Mending does not. 0: no limit. Range: 0 to 1000.
config.dioriteisntuseless.axe.durability: Maximum durability of the Dioritine Axe and the Dioritine Pickaxe. Requires restarting the game. Tools you already have keep their wear. Range: 1 to 10000.
config.dioriteisntuseless.axe.restrictEn: On: the axe and the pickaxe only accept Efficiency and Mending. Off: they accept the same enchantments as a vanilla axe or pickaxe.
config.dioriteisntuseless.pickaxe.enable: Breaking stone or an ore with the Dioritine Pickaxe also breaks the stone and ores around it, in a 3x3 square facing you. When off, it works like a normal pickaxe: one block at a time.
config.dioriteisntuseless.pickaxe.dropsA: Drops at the block you hit
On: everything drops together at the block you hit. Off: each block drops where it was.
config.dioriteisntuseless.pickaxe.sneakM: Whether sneaking stops or starts 3x3 mining.
config.dioriteisntuseless.pickaxe.strike: The pickaxe breaks after this many 3x3 strikes, no matter its durability. Repairing it on an anvil with Dioritine Ingots resets the count; Mending does not. Range: 1 to 1000.
config.dioriteisntuseless.pickaxe.minBlo: Fewest blocks a 3x3 swing has to break, counting the one you hit, to count as a strike. Swings that break fewer, at edges and corners, still use durability.
config.dioriteisntuseless.abuseMode.enab: The mod reacts when diorite is abused. Disable it if you only want the tools and blocks.
config.dioriteisntuseless.abuseMode.conf: Abuse mode is what gives this mod its soul.

Without it, The Miner will be gone, and diorite will stay quiet.
Are you sure?
config.dioriteisntuseless.abuseMode.jump: On: some moments come with a sudden, loud sound. Off: the same moments, quietly. There are never flashing lights either way.
config.dioriteisntuseless.abuseMode.tree: Whole trees felled with the Dioritine Axe, after reaching the previous stage, to reach this one. Trees and pickaxe strikes add up: half the trees and half the strikes are enough. Range: 1 to 1000.
Whole trees felled with the Dioritine Axe, after reaching stage 4, to reach the final stage. Trees and pickaxe strikes add up. Range: 1 to 1000.
config.dioriteisntuseless.abuseMode.pick: 3x3 strikes with the Dioritine Pickaxe, after reaching the previous stage, to reach this one. Trees and strikes add up: half the trees and half the strikes are enough. Range: 1 to 1000.
advancements.dioriteisntuseless.wear_out: Wear out a Dioritine Axe. Congratulations on putting diorite to good use!
